**How Turbonomic Helps Unilever Leverage AI for Multi‑Cloud Observability**

| Aspect | What Turbonomic Brings | Why It Matters for Unilever |
|--------|-----------------------|-----------------------------|
| **Unified Visibility** | A single pane of glass that aggregates metrics, logs, and events from all clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP, on‑prem, edge). | Unilever can see the health of its entire digital estate without switching dashboards. |
| **Real‑Time AI‑Driven Insights** | Uses machine learning to detect anomalies, predict capacity issues, and recommend remediation actions before they become outages. | Reduces downtime and improves customer experience across e‑commerce, supply‑chain, and marketing platforms. |
| **Automated Remediation** | Executes policy‑based actions (scale up/down, move workloads, change instance types) automatically or via API. | Frees operations teams to focus on strategy rather than firefighting. |
| **Cost Optimization** | Continuously evaluates spend vs performance, suggesting rightsizing, spot/low‑cost instances, and reserved‑instance purchases. | Helps Unilever keep cloud budgets under control while maintaining performance SLAs. |
| **Compliance & Governance** | Enforces security, regulatory, and internal policies across all environments. | Ensures data residency, GDPR, and industry standards are met automatically. |
| **Predictive Capacity Planning** | Forecasts future demand based on historical trends and business calendars. | Enables proactive scaling for seasonal spikes (e.g., holiday sales). |
| **Multi‑Tenant & Role‑Based Access** | Supports granular permissions for different business units or regions. | Allows each Unilever division to manage its own workloads while keeping overall governance intact. |

**Key Differences Between Turbonomic and Native Cloud Tools**

| Feature | Turbonomic | Native Cloud Tool (GCP, AWS, Azure) |
|---------|------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Scope** | Cross‑cloud + on‑prem + edge | Single‑cloud only |
| **Observability Layer** | Adds a unified layer on top of native telemetry (CloudWatch, Stackdriver, Monitor) | Provides native telemetry but limited to one provider |
| **AI & Automation** | Continuous, real‑time ML models that drive automated actions | Mostly rule‑based alerts; automation requires separate services (Lambda, Functions, Logic Apps) |
| **Policy Engine** | Centralized policy definition that spans all clouds | Policies are defined per provider; cross‑cloud coordination is manual |
| **Cost Management** | Unified cost view with actionable recommendations | Cost Explorer / Advisor per provider; requires stitching data manually |
| **Governance** | Enterprise‑grade compliance engine that can enforce across multiple clouds | Compliance dashboards are provider‑specific; cross‑cloud enforcement is not built‑in |
| **Integration** | APIs, SDKs, and connectors for CI/CD, ticketing, chatops | Each provider has its own integration ecosystem; cross‑cloud integration needs custom work |
| **Operational Overhead** | One platform to learn, operate, and support | Multiple platforms to maintain, each with its own learning curve |

**Bottom Line for Unilever**

Turbonomic acts as a *single, AI‑powered orchestrator* that sits above the native tools of GCP, AWS, and Azure. It consolidates data, automates decisions, and enforces policies across the entire multi‑cloud stack—something that would otherwise require building a complex, custom solution using each provider’s native services. This leads to faster time‑to‑value, lower operational costs, and higher confidence that Unilever’s global digital services stay performant, compliant, and cost‑effective.
